synopsis: ASAM OpenSCENARIO describes scenarios, while OpenDRIVE describes roads; OpenSCENARIO has an XML form [f16017, f13010]. The booklet recommends keeping the scenario catalog in a manufacturer-owned, domain-neutral, version-controlled Scenic or in-house YAML representation, then exporting to OpenSCENARIO for tools that require it [f14491, f7204]. Tool support spans VTD, the dSPACE chain, CARLA, RoadRunner, Prescan and MORAI, with native support specifically reported for VTD ScenarioEngine [f16017, f9200]. An open co-simulation demo combines OpenSCENARIO and OSI with OpenMATERIAL 3D and a physical lidar model, illustrating use beyond catalog exchange [f3981]. OpenSCENARIO, OpenDRIVE and OSI are described as open, free and ongoing, but their road heritage is a scope caveat for heavy off-road applications; the supplied facts give no version numbers or release dates [f9214, f9217, f9218, f9215].

relations.note: Both recommend exporting the scenario catalog to OpenSCENARIO when required by tools.
